\section{Mathematical Typography}

Inline math uses optimal spacing: $\lVert x\rVert_2 = \sqrt{\sum_{i=1}^n x_i^2}$ for $x \in \mathbb{R}^n$.

Display equation with baseline alignment:
\begin{equation}
f(x) = \int_{-\infty}^{\infty} g(t) e^{-2\pi i x t} \, dt
\end{equation}
